platform.news-feed.expected_result: An unset URL makes no feed request and uses static content. Remote failures fall back. At the recorded source revision the legacy latest route returns empty content, so the whole two-operation claim is not established.

use_cases.title: Show installation news without a live feed
use_cases.description: An operator uses the static quadrant fallback where outbound feed access is unnecessary.

platform.observability.purpose: Inspect deployment logs and export telemetry to an existing observability stack.
prerequisites: Appropriate administrator access for log content and analysis
For telemetry export, enabled collectors and a configured OTLP endpoint
steps: List and read the relevant deployment logs or supported analysis output
Read resource-readiness counts while distinguishing missing configuration from service health
Enable and verify telemetry delivery to the intended backend when required
platform.observability.expected_result: Readiness counts configured resources rather than probing liveness. Some UI log functions lack matching routes. Telemetry export is not alerting, paging or incident workflow, and retention and volume limits are not characterized here.

use_cases.title: Investigate a model startup problem
use_cases.description: An administrator reads the deployment's logs and correlates available telemetry in the organization's own monitoring system.

platform.operations-and-notifications.purpose: Read the current user's platform operation and notification feeds.
prerequisites: An authenticated platform identity
Access to the recipient-scoped feed API
steps: List the user's operations or notifications through the API
Read the selected item and its operation state
Mark it seen or dismiss it when appropriate
platform.operations-and-notifications.expected_result: Feeds persist per user and remain recipient-scoped. The API does not establish a shipped UI or outbound delivery. This operation lifecycle is separate from aggregate usage and audit queries.

use_cases.title: Track a requested platform operation
use_cases.description: A user reads the recorded operation state and dismisses its notification after reviewing it.

platform.tenant-namespace-install.purpose: Prepare a namespace-scoped Helm installation on a customer-owned cluster.
prerequisites: A platform-prepared namespace, storage, pull credentials, edge and required security bindings
A namespace administrator with supplemental installer Roles
Explicit platform and routing values, including required egress CIDRs
steps: Have the platform team verify environment-specific prerequisites and node settings
Render the selected tenant-direct configuration and inspect it against the tenant contract
Install into the prepared namespace, then separately verify application and model paths
platform.tenant-namespace-install.expected_result: Tenant-direct creates namespaced resources without a Node-read grant. This does not qualify every target or GPU path. The shipped EZUA overlay adds cluster-scoped node-reader permissions, and the target support matrix remains unqualified. Fixed model pod IDs can conflict with OpenShift security constraints.

use_cases.title: Prepare a constrained tenant installation
use_cases.description: A customer's platform team supplies prerequisites and reviews rendered permissions before a namespace administrator installs the release.

platform.usage-and-audit.purpose: Query recorded user activity and authorization decisions.
prerequisites: An administrator permitted to read activity and decision exports
A configured logging or telemetry backend when durable decision retention is needed
steps: Read the recent activity feed through the API or SDK
Export the available authorization decisions
Correlate the scoped records with retained logs, noting replica and retention boundaries
platform.usage-and-audit.expected_result: Activity writes are best effort. Decision exports are bounded process-local buffers lost on restart. This surface is not an authentication-session audit trail, report generator or redaction tool, and activity retention is not established.

use_cases.title: Review recent resource-access decisions
use_cases.description: An administrator inspects available decision records and uses the configured log backend for any longer-lived review.

retrieval.async-retrieval-jobs.purpose: Retrieve a registered dataset through an asynchronous job.
prerequisites: A catalog dataset URN and viewer or higher access
The required workroom read context
For Arrow Flight, reachable trusted TLS endpoints
steps: Create the retrieval job for the dataset URN
Poll its state or read SSE results, or fetch Flight batches where available
Use the REST route to mark an owned job canceled, without relying on it to stop in-flight SSE delivery
retrieval.async-retrieval-jobs.expected_result: Jobs are dataset-addressed and owner-checked. The SDK cannot materialize Kafka or cancel jobs here. Offset, filters and ordering belong to a separate query-jobs contract; setting them on this route is rejected. A recorded cancellation changed status while SSE continued delivering data; cancellation is not a reliable delivery cutoff.

use_cases.title: Read a large permitted dataset
use_cases.description: An integration follows a retrieval job without holding one blocking request and handles the selected result transport explicitly.

security.consent-and-banners.purpose: Configure acknowledgment text and classification banners.
prerequisites: An administrator and explicitly enabled consent or banner settings
A reviewed public configuration and trusted proxy setup
The embed script included by extensions that must display the markings
steps: Set the approved consent text, banner text and colors through supported configuration
Include the provided embed script on applicable extension surfaces
Check the displayed content and acceptance behavior through the actual edge
security.consent-and-banners.expected_result: Consent is acknowledgment rather than authorization. Extension coverage depends on including the script. Acceptance is browser-session scoped, not a durable per-user ledger. On the embed script and Legacy client, any failed acceptance request can admit the user without a server audit event; the newer client blocks on failure.

use_cases.title: Apply an approved usage acknowledgment
use_cases.description: A deployment administrator configures approved text and checks it on the main UI and each integrated extension.

skills.skills-library.purpose: Import and curate reusable agent instruction packages.
prerequisites: Skills read context for discovery and write context for mutation or export
A ZIP with a valid SKILL.md and supported optional resources
steps: Import the package as a draft and inspect its metadata and contents
Curate and publish it through the allowed lifecycle
Download the published package or export the intended snapshot or bundle, archiving or deleting when appropriate
skills.skills-library.expected_result: The library preserves package identity and shares authorized skills. Import validates structure, not behavioral safety or quality, and the library does not execute the skill. Enabling it in an agent is a separate consuming workflow.

use_cases.title: Share a reviewed team instruction package
use_cases.description: A curator imports a repeatable instruction package, reviews it, and publishes it for permitted consumers.

tools.mcp-tool-shed.purpose: Deploy and discover managed MCP tool servers.
prerequisites: An authenticated caller and an available template or supported container image
Required credentials supplied through managed configuration
Administrator authority for catalog refresh or template administration
steps: Select a locally available tool template or image and provide required configuration
Deploy it and inspect the recorded status and endpoint
Connect an authorized MCP client and test the needed tool, then stop the deployment when finished
tools.mcp-tool-shed.expected_result: Discovery returns names, URLs and status, with no populated capability list. The health route reads stored deployment status rather than contacting MCP. This legacy surface is deprecated in favor of extensions, and agent permissions remain a separate concern.

use_cases.title: Prepare a managed tool endpoint
use_cases.description: An operator deploys a tool server and independently checks the MCP operation the consuming application needs.

workrooms.org-decommission.purpose: Retire an organization's workrooms under an explicitly confirmed plan.
prerequisites: A tenant administrator with an approved retirement decision
A reviewed room inventory, future timezone-aware cutoff and retention contact
Awareness that creating a draft immediately disables new room creation
steps: List the room inventory and review the intended retirement scope
Create the plan only when ready for its room-creation side effect, then inspect it
Confirm with the exact organization name and follow read-only state, deletion processing and tombstones
workrooms.org-decommission.expected_result: Confirmation archives planned rooms and the background task deletes them at cutoff. There is no cancel route, both strategy values behave alike, and changed inventory can strand a draft until expiry handling.

use_cases.title: Prepare an approved organization shutdown
use_cases.description: An administrator reviews an authorized retirement plan and its irreversible consequences before confirming it.
